title: Ion Cognitive Engine X
description: Built as the Signature version of Llama 4 — agentic language model family, the Ion Cognitive Engine X reproduces its operational facts in original expression — mixture-of-experts models aimed at agentic workloads. Its 2025 release positioned it for agent builders.
